reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves exact need-to-capability handoffs by matching capability records to needs on the full need text and marking non-matches unsupported. The assigned output shows the two unsupported needs remain unsupported while the six supplied capabilities map directly.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: it sets unsupported to true when coverage is direct. This makes supported/direct capabilities appear as unsupported priorities and pushes actually unsupported needs behind them, contradicting the coverage semantics visible in the assigned output.

synthesize_recommendation deterministically selects the first retained priority and emits prioritize only when that row is marked unsupported. The bad recommendation is downstream of the inverted unsupported flag supplied by prioritize_needs, not localized in this unit.
